# Character Abilities 

## Ability Scores

 A bonus or penalty is associated with each score, as shown on the table below.

| Ability Score | Bonus/Penalty |
|:------:|:------:|
| 3 | -3 |
| 4-5 | -2 |
| 6-8 | -1 |
| 9-12 | 0 |
| 13-15 | +1 |
| 16-17 | +2 |
| 18 | +3 |

**Strength:** Raw physical power, modifies melee attack and damage rolls.

**Intelligence:** Learning and applying knowledge. Modifies the number of languages your character knows. A penalty indicates that your character is illiterate.

**Wisdom:** Intuition and willpower. Modifies your save vs. magic.

**Dexterity:** Quickness and balance, modifies ranged attack (but not damage) rolls.

**Constitution:** Health and general vitality. Modifies hit point rolls.

**Charisma:** Ability to influence and lead people. Modifies reaction rolls and the number of [retainers](hirelings.qmd#retainers) a character may hire.

### Ability Prime Requisite

All classes have a Prime Requisite attribute. The value of your Prime Requisite may grant an experience point bonus (or penalty):

| Score | Bonus / Penalty |
|:------:|:------:|
| 3-5 | -10% |
| 6-8 | -5% |
| 9-12 | 0% |
| 13-15 | +5% |
| 16-18 | +10% |

## Languages

All characters begin the game knowing their native language, often called "Common." Each demi-human race has its own language, i.e. Elvish, Dwarvish, Halfling.

Characters with a positive Intelligence modifier begin knowing that many additional languages. Rare, dead, or otherworldly languages count as two languages.
